  - region "Simple English explanation of Distance from Point to Plane":
    - group:
      - text: In simple English
      - heading "Understand Distance from Point to Plane" [level=2]
  - text: CLASS 12 • THREE-DIMENSIONAL GEOMETRY
  - heading "Distance from Point to Plane" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Drop a perpendicular from point Q to plane and explore signed distance, foot of perpendicular, and the geometry.
  - text: 18 min ADVANCED CONCEPT geometry3d
  - main:
    - article:
      - heading "3D INTERACTIVE LAB" [level=3]
      - navigation:
        - button "3D View"
        - button "Side View"
        - button "Reset":
          - img
          - text: Reset
        - checkbox "Show grid" [checked]
        - text: Show grid
      - img "Point and perpendicular projection onto plane": Q(1, 2, 4) H(0.3333, 2.3333, 3.3333) 2x-y+2z-5=0
      - paragraph: Drag Q to explore. The foot H and all values update in real time.
      - text: Zoom
      - slider "Scene zoom": "1"
    - complementary:
      - heading "CONTROL & READOUT" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Drag Q or move along the normal.
      - strong: Q=(1, 2, 4)
      - slider "Signed distance along normal": "1"
      - paragraph: "Plane: 2x-y+2z-5=0"
      - paragraph: "Normal: n=(2,-1,2), |n|=3"
      - text: Signed numerator n·Q-5
      - strong: "3"
      - text: Signed distance
      - strong: 3/3 = 1
      - text: Point-to-plane distance
      - strong: "|3|/3 = 1"
      - text: Foot of perpendicular H
      - paragraph: H=Q-((n·Q-5)/|n|²)n
      - strong: (0.3333, 2.3333, 3.3333)
    - text: Angle between QH and n 0.00° Distance |QH| 1 Signed side Positive (above) QH ⟂ Plane Verified
    - img
    - article:
      - heading "FORMULA & DERIVATION" [level=3]
      - paragraph: "For plane ax+by+cz+d=0 with normal n=(a,b,c):"
      - strong: Distance=|ax₀+by₀+cz₀+d|/√(a²+b²+c²)
      - paragraph: Signed distance=(n·Q+d)/|n|
      - strong: H=Q-((n·Q+d)/|n|²)n
    - article:
      - heading "SUBSTITUTION VERIFICATION (H LIES ON PLANE)" [level=3]
      - paragraph: H=(0.3333, 2.3333, 3.3333)
      - paragraph: 2(0.3333)-(2.3333)+2(3.3333)-5
      - strong: "0"
      - text: "Verified: H lies on the plane"
    - article:
      - heading "KEY REMINDERS" [level=3]
      - list:
        - listitem: Use absolute value for distance.
        - listitem: Without absolute value, you get signed distance.
        - listitem: Normalize by |n|, not |n|².
      - heading "WORKED EXAMPLE" [level=3]
      - paragraph: For Q=(1,2,4), numerator=3, distance=1 and H=(1/3,7/3,10/3).
    - heading "HOW IT WORKS" [level=3]
    - text: 1 Drag Q Move point Q anywhere in 3D. 2 Perpendicular drops QH is perpendicular to the plane. 3 Read values Signed side, distance, and foot update. 4 Verify H always lies on the plane.
    - article:
      - heading "PRACTICE TIME" [level=3]
      - text: 1. Find three point-plane distances
      - paragraph: Solve using the current formula and verify by substitution.
      - button "Show answer":
        - img
        - text: Show answer
      - text: 2. Find the perpendicular feet
      - paragraph: Solve using the current formula and verify by substitution.
      - button "Show answer":
        - img
        - text: Show answer
      - text: 3. True or false
      - paragraph: Solve using the current formula and verify by substitution.
      - button "Show answer":
        - img
        - text: Show answer
      - text: 4. Concept check
      - paragraph: Solve using the current formula and verify by substitution.
      - button "Show answer":
        - img
        - text: Show answer
    - article:
      - heading "ONE-SIDED LIMIT CHECK (ALONG NORMAL)" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Move on L(t)=Q+t n and evaluate f(L(t))=2x-y+2z-5.
      - paragraph: Plane crossing parameter t₀=-0.3333
      - text: ε=0.100
      - slider "Limit epsilon": "0.1"
      - text: "From below: f(L(t₀-ε))=-0.9 From above: f(L(t₀+ε))=0.9 At t₀: f(L(t₀))=0 Signs match the signed-side readout."
